review_notes: I read the whole file. It defines One, Mul, MulOneClass, Semigroup and Monoid instances on SubMulAction, plus coe_one, coe_mul, coe_pow and related lemmas. I grepped Mathlib for other One or Mul instances on SubMulAction and found only the two in this file, so there is no competing declaration. The structures reuse the set-level Pointwise operations (Set.image2, Set.mul_mem_mul, and the Set semigroup via mul_assoc on sets). The Submodule pointwise structure is on a different type, so it is not a duplicate concept. I did not check every Mathlib file for a differently named equivalent, but I found no evidence of one.
